Quick summary / asks so we can make the demo productive:
- Which environments will the demo need to access (on-prem, VPC peering, or air-gapped)?
- Will PHI be used in the demo? If yes, please confirm whether synthetic data is acceptable for the initial walkthrough.
- Any compliance docs you want up front (SOC 2, HIPAA BAAs, network diagrams)? We can share a short SOC2 summary and our private-deploy playbook before the call.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2027-06-02 09:30 - 10:15 (preferred)
- Wed 2027-06-03 14:30 - 15:15
- Thu 2027-06-03 16:00 - 16:30 (short follow-up)

If those don’t work, tell me a window and I’ll coordinate with engineering.

I’ve attached a SOC2 summary and our private deployment playbook starter. I’ll loop in Aditya (solutions engineer) and Soojin (compliance liaison) on any evidence requests.

Karthik — thanks for the quick reply and for sending the docs. A couple notes from our side:

- We do plan to use a small set of de-identified PHI for the demo; synthetic is possible but we’d prefer a short run using tokenized sample records to validate latency/throughput on our environment.
- We need to see a network diagram and confirmation around inbound/outbound ports and whether the on-prem package supports an air-gapped mode (our security team will want this spelled out).
- The SOC2 summary looks good — can you also provide a signed BAA template? I’ve cc’ed our compliance inbox (compliance@neurolytix.com).

Regarding times: the 9:30 PT slot on Tue 6/2 works, but we have a conflict on Wed after 3pm. If you could give us a 9:30-10:15 PT confirmation that would be ideal. Also — two of our infra leads need to join; can we extend to 10:30 if we need to run a quick troubleshooting step?

Thanks,
Maya Gupta
